pad the bill: The dishonest mechanic tried to pad the bill by charging us for repairs he never actually did.
那個不誠實的技師試圖灌水帳單，向我們收取他根本沒做的修理費用。
pad out an essay: Some students pad out an essay with long quotes just to reach the 500-word limit their teacher set.
有些學生用長篇引文來灌水文章，只為了達到老師規定的500字。
pad around the house: On lazy Sunday mornings, I like to pad around the house in my soft slippers, drinking hot tea.
在慵懶的週日早晨，我喜歡穿著柔軟的拖鞋在家輕步走，喝著熱茶。
paint a picture of: In his letters, the soldier tried to paint a picture of daily life at the front for his family back home.
這名士兵在信中試著為家鄉的家人描繪前線日常生活的景象。
paint a rosy picture: The salesman tried to paint a rosy picture of the old apartment, but we soon found many problems.
推銷員試圖把那間舊公寓描繪得很美好，但我們很快就發現許多問題。
paint the town red: After passing the college entrance exam, Jack and his friends went out to paint the town red all night.
通過大學入學考試後，傑克和朋友們出去狂歡了一整夜。
paint someone as a villain: Some news reports tried to paint the coach as a villain, even though he had done nothing wrong.
有些新聞報導試圖把教練描繪成壞人，即使他沒做錯任何事。
panic buying: When news of the typhoon spread, panic buying left the supermarket shelves empty of water and instant noodles.
颱風消息傳開後，恐慌搶購使超市架上的水和泡麵被一掃而空。
don't panic: Don't panic, everyone — it's only a fire drill, so there is nothing to be afraid of.
大家別慌——這只是消防演習，沒有什麼好害怕的。
panic at the sight of: My little sister tends to panic at the sight of a cockroach and screams until someone comes to help.
我妹妹一看到蟑螂就慌，會一直尖叫直到有人來幫忙。
panic attack: During the important speech, he suddenly had a panic attack, and his heart started beating very fast.
在那場重要的演講中，他突然恐慌發作，心跳開始變得非常快。
parade one's wealth: He likes to parade his wealth by driving expensive cars to school and showing off his designer bags.
他喜歡炫富，開名車到學校並炫耀他的名牌包。
parade through the streets: After winning the championship, the team paraded through the streets on an open bus while fans cheered.
贏得冠軍後，球隊搭乘敞篷巴士遊行過街，球迷們在旁歡呼。
parade as an expert: Be careful of people who parade as experts online; many of them have no real training and just want to sell products.
要小心網路上冒充專家的人；他們很多人沒受過真正的訓練，只想賣產品。
on parade: At the fashion show, the designer's newest spring dresses were on parade for buyers from all over the world.
在時裝秀上，這位設計師最新的春季洋裝向來自世界各地的買家展示。
parallel the growth: The rise in online shopping has tended to parallel the growth of smartphone use over the past ten years.
過去十年來，網購的興起往往與智慧型手機使用的成長同步。
draw a parallel between: In class, our teacher asked us to draw a parallel between the two novels and discuss how the heroes were alike.
課堂上，老師要我們將這兩本小說相比，並討論主角們有何相似之處。
without parallel: The view from the top of the mountain at sunrise is without parallel; nothing else I've seen is as beautiful.
日出時從山頂看出去的景色無與倫比；我見過的任何景色都沒有這麼美。
run parallel to: The new bike path will run parallel to the river, so cyclists can enjoy the water view as they ride.
新的自行車道將與河流平行，讓騎士們騎車時能欣賞河景。
pass a law: The government plans to pass a law that will make all plastic straws illegal in restaurants next year.
政府計劃通過一項法律，明年起餐廳將全面禁用塑膠吸管。
pass judgment: We shouldn't pass judgment on new classmates before we have taken the time to really know them.
在我們花時間真正了解新同學之前，不應該評斷他們。
pass the time: While waiting for the delayed flight, we played cards and read comic books to pass the time.
在等待延誤的班機時，我們玩牌、看漫畫來打發時間。
pass away: My grandfather was ninety-five when he passed away peacefully in his sleep, surrounded by his family.
我祖父在九十五歲時，在家人陪伴下安詳地於睡夢中過世。
pass the buck: When the project failed, the manager tried to pass the buck to his assistant instead of taking responsibility.
專案失敗時，經理試圖把責任推給助理，而不是自己承擔。
pass up a chance: Don't pass up a chance to study abroad; an experience like that may only come once in your life.
不要放棄出國留學的機會；那樣的經驗一生也許只有一次。
pass out: It was so hot during the outdoor ceremony that two students passed out and had to be taken to the nurse.
戶外典禮時天氣太熱，有兩名學生昏倒，必須被送到保健室。
pass for: With her short hair and simple clothes, my mother could easily pass for a college student.
我媽媽留著短髮、穿著簡單，很容易被當成大學生。
patch things up: After their big fight last week, the two best friends finally patched things up with each other over dinner.
上週大吵一架後，這對好朋友終於在晚餐時和好了。
patch a hole: My grandmother used a small piece of cloth to patch a hole in the knee of my old jeans.
我奶奶用一小塊布為我舊牛仔褲膝蓋上的破洞補洞。
a rough patch: Our family went through a rough patch when my father lost his job, but we stayed together and got through it.
我爸爸失業時，我們家經歷了一段低潮期，但我們團結在一起度過了難關。
patch up a wound: The school nurse quickly cleaned and helped patch up a wound on my leg after I fell on the playground.
我在操場跌倒後，學校護理師很快幫我清潔並包紮腿上的傷口。
patch the software: The company had to patch the software quickly after hackers found a serious security problem in it.
駭客在軟體中發現嚴重的安全問題後，公司必須迅速修補軟體。
